_comment: Worked example: the DynaClinic 3D runbook demo. 'at' = wall-clock time on 'date' from the recording's steps.log / backend log. 'list' = short label for the demo page step list (HTML allowed). 'chapter' starts a chapter.

intro.title: DynaClinic in 3D: runbook demo
lines: Dynamic architecture switching for clinical decision support
Meta-Controller triage -> Primary Care Agent or Integrated Care Team
Divergence above tau -> adversarial Clinical Critic -> Layer 4 safety gates
Real runs, recorded live. Model: OpenAI gpt-6-luna
Idle stretches longer than 2.5 s are shortened; nothing else is cut

outro.title: What you just saw
lines: A  LOW      -> Primary Care Agent only                      -> A (correct)
B  HIGH     -> care team agrees, divergence 0.16           -> B (correct)
C  HIGH     -> care team disagrees, divergence 0.59        -> Critic -> C (correct)
Scenario C switched in 4 of 8 real runs (table in the runbook)
